title: Software Engineer
description: Led a performance-improvement study for NOAA's Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites (GOES), specifically the GOES-R Series ground system developed under a contract valued at up to $1.833 billion. Prototyped a segmentation approach for its Oracle Coherence data grid that reduced average CPU utilization by a factor of 10 and demonstrated a path to support additional algorithm processing on existing infrastructure.
highlights: Profiled CPU and memory utilization in the Oracle Coherence-based Data Fabric.
Prototyped data segmentation by query name to reduce the amount of data held by each segment.
Reduced average CPU utilization by a factor of 10 in the prototype, as documented in the GOES-R algorithm study.
Established an implementation path for adding processing capacity without expanding the existing infrastructure.
